best_idea: Put one-shot stingers on their own music slot and duck the background bed with a wall-clock ramp, and have state-driven music check the track name each frame instead of restarting it.
decision_why: A death or boss-intro sting sits over the zone bed without cutting it, and the client only reads fight state, so it fits the one-engine ruling; the fixed 500 ms ramp and silence floor become data, and the stinger needs a priority the donor does not have.
acceptance: A death sting plays once, the zone bed falls to silence within 500 ms, and the bed returns when the sting ends; a client test asserts the duck gain is 0.5 after 250 ms and that a second request for the same sting name returns false.
